text_block_list.text:
While out with Satono Diamond, I spotted 
Kitasan Black deep in conversation with a 
greengrocer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's the matter, Kita-chan? You've 
got a troubled look on your face...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Dia-chan. Looks like the greengrocer 
is having some trouble...

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Ah man, I've got so many leftover 
veggies... Hardly any customers came by at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Get 'em cheap, cheap prices here... Fresh, 
delicious vegetables...

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
See? Every time my favorite baseball team 
loses, this happens. Talk about an 
annoying jinx, sheesh...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The greengrocer said they've been troubled 
by this jinx many times before.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Mmuh!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mister, jinxes can be broken! Let's face 
it head-on and not give up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
For instance... how would it be if I were 
to buy all the vegetables here?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Then in a different way...! I want to 
help people in trouble too!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I know! Please let me help you sell the 
vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! Allow me to help break that 
jinx!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Everyone from the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fresh vegetables, get your vegetables 
right here!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text: What's going on, what's going on!?

Kitasan Black's booming voice echoed 
through the shopping arcade, causing 
passersby to stop in their tracks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Juicy tomatoes and glossy eggplants! How 
about some for dinner tonight~?

text_block_list.name: Housewife
text_block_list.text:
My, how lively~. Maybe I'll take a quick 
peek.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I recommend all of them♪ Please, take a 
look.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, looking good! Super effective!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to Kita-chan's powerful 
voice, huh♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan's customer service is great too! 
Her usual politeness is really shining 
through!
(*Chatter, chatter, buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Damn, this is...! My favorite lost, but 
I've never felt like this before!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, we didn't do anything special, you 
know? If the old gentleman had been well, 
it would have flourished just the same 
without us, I'm sure.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right! Come to think of it, we 
didn't hear the usual energetic chant 
today!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true...! Now that you mention 
it, I was being weak-willed and couldn't 
put out any power.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"We won't let some jinx beat us!" "Let's 
just not worry about it and have fun!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"If we pour those feelings into our 
voices, we can blow any jinx right away♪"
choice_data_list: Staying positive is the best way to go!
Can you blow away any jinx?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right, why don't we look for other 
people troubled by jinxes? We might be 
able to help them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! Let's go ask the folks in 
the shopping district!

The three of them strolled through the 
shopping district, searching high and low 
for unseen jinxes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you doubting me by any chance? If 
so, I'll just break the jinx once again to 
prove it!

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer Uncle
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about that, we've got one 
too! 'When sales are good, you end up with 
leftover cucumbers'—that kind of jinx!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then let's spread the appeal of cucumbers. 
For instance... maybe showcase delicious 
ways to eat them?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like a great idea! I'll ask 
the three-star chef who's been taking care 
of me how to make it♪

The live sales demonstration was a huge 
success, and Satono Diamond and the others 
managed to sell every last cucumber!
